title: Source evidence versus consolidated cards: fixed-query retrieval audit
scope: Four independently authored source-informed queries frozen before card/ranking inspection. Descriptive known-support retrieval, not blind/human accuracy or a reproduction of Google sleep training.

settings.lexical_fit: source chunks only; cards and queries transformed without refitting
settings.source_score: maximum unit cosine; length/card multiplicity remains a confound
settings.hybrid: reciprocal rank fusion of raw-source and qualified-card source ranks
settings.tuning: Initial four conditions fixed before rankings; a fixed top5 fusion is added after the first results as a disclosed reviewer-driven design repair. No query/card changes or search over k.

protocol_amendments.stage: After first executed run; before corrected run
protocol_amendments.reason: Independent reviewer derived a structural coverage bias without inspecting rankings. Root had already executed the initial conditions, so this change is explicitly post-hoc.
protocol_amendments.change: Retain naive full-list fusion and add a single fixed top5-candidate RRF followed by raw-source tail. No query wording, relevance labels, card text or representation parameters changed.
protocol_amendments.scope: Design repair and sensitivity, not held-out evidence that a tuned retriever generalizes.

naive_fusion_coverage_bias.interpretation: Full-list RRF with this incomplete card index is structurally coverage-biased regardless of query meaning; its failures do not establish a general defect in hybrid retrieval or consolidation.

model.token_pooling: Attention-mask mean including CLS/SEP, then chunk L2 normalization
model.document_pooling: Content-wordpiece-weighted mean of normalized chunks, then document L2 normalization
model.cache: No disk cache; vectors retained in memory during execution

queries.query: Does the proposed interstellar council include its nonphysical initiators as physical members, and is there a definite start date?
queries.relevance_scope: At least this source directly supports the requested information; every unlisted source remains unjudged, not nonrelevant.
queries.rationale: Combines two explicit negative qualifications: the attributed initiators do not physically sit on the council, and the text declines a physical-convening timeframe.

queries.query: How does the text reconcile individual self-sufficiency with sharing resources, rather than withdrawing into hoarding?
queries.relevance_scope: At least this source directly supports the requested information; every unlisted source remains unjudged, not nonrelevant.
queries.rationale: Retrieves the stated connection between less dependency, communal sharing and explicit rejection of isolated hoarding; no endorsement of the source’s economic claims.

queries.query: What practice is offered for highly sensitive people who lose their own boundaries while seeking affirmation from others?
queries.relevance_scope: At least this source directly supports the requested information; every unlisted source remains unjudged, not nonrelevant.
queries.rationale: Retrieves the source’s inner-child/teacher exercise and self-awareness/boundary framing, not a clinical recommendation or established psychological mechanism.

queries.query: During rapid change, does the recommended response involve chasing events or finding an unchanging internal point of awareness?
queries.relevance_scope: At least this source directly supports the requested information; every unlisted source remains unjudged, not nonrelevant.
queries.rationale: Retrieves the contrast between feeling left behind and attending to an internal anchor, together with the actual awareness/breathing instructions.

limitations: Only four purposive AI-authored queries and source-informed known supports; this is neither human ground truth nor a representative evaluation.
Unlisted sources are unjudged, not irrelevant. Hit rate and reciprocal rank concern only the declared known supporting sources.
Card authors saw source answers. Cards cover a selected subset and may have been written for related analyst questions, despite independent query freezing.
The answer-only card ablation intentionally omits separate qualifiers from the retrieval text; the full knowledge database always retains them.
Source maxima favor documents with more chunks; card maxima favor sources with more cards. Index sizes, formats and source coverage differ.
TF-IDF is fitted on raw-source chunks only. Card paraphrases can contain out-of-vocabulary terms; MiniLM is an older cached baseline, not a current SOTA claim.
Retrieving a source does not establish that a generated answer would retain its negation, conditions or time scope. No automated answer generation is evaluated.
Naive full-list fusion mechanically promotes every card-covered source over uncovered sources. The top5 candidate fusion is a disclosed post-hoc repair, not a held-out improvement claim.
Shuffle ranges are descriptive negative controls, not significance tests. No search over fusion settings or changes to frozen queries/cards were made.
This is source-bound index consolidation. No language-model parameters, Google memory experts or synthetic-dream training are implemented.
